content_sections.heading: NHM Jharkhand Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026 carries 51 total contractual vacancies across 9 Accounts and Management positions. The department reserves the right to cancel any or all positions, and the number of vacant positions may vary as per requirement.

rows.essential_qualification_experience: Professional Qualified Chartered Accountant from ICAI, New Delhi. At least 2 years of post-qualification practice, or employed as a Chartered Accountant in a reputed firm/organization for a minimum of 2 years.

Inter Chartered Accountant/MBA (Finance)/Inter ICWA/Masters in Commerce/CFA, with a minimum of 10 years of post-qualification related work experience, and good working skills on computer and financial software.
Inter CA/Inter ICWA/M.Com with knowledge of Tally software, minimum 8 years post-qualification related work experience, and working skills on computer and financial software.

Inter CA/Inter ICWA/M.Com/MBA in Finance with Tally knowledge, minimum 3 years post-qualification relevant work experience (preferably in the government sector), and good working skills on computer and financial software (Tally). Fluency in English and Hindi is desirable.

MBA in Finance or Financial Management or Accounts, with a minimum of 3 years of post-qualification experience in Audit/Maintenance of accounts on double entry system in a recognized Society or Institution.

Masters/Post Graduate Degree in Commerce from a recognized University/College with minimum 55% aggregate marks or equivalent grade. Minimum 3 years of post-qualification work experience as an accountant in a reputed organization, preferably government. Good computer/Tally skills, fluency in English and Hindi, and knowledge of Government accounting procedures required.
Inter CA/Inter ICWA/M.Com with working knowledge of computer and accounting software (Tally). Minimum 3 years of post-qualification work experience in the relevant field in a reputed organization.

M.Com with minimum 55% marks. Minimum 3 years post-qualification related work experience as accountant in a reputed organization, preferably in health. Computer/Tally skills, fluency in English/Hindi, and knowledge of Government accounting procedures required.
Inter CA/Inter ICWA/B.Com. Minimum 3 years post-qualification work experience in the relevant field, with working skills on computer and financial software.

content_sections.heading: NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age is calculated as on the reference date, 1 August 2026, as per Government of Jharkhand memo (Department of Personnel, Administrative Reforms) dated 27 November 2012. For posts where additional work experience is an essential criterion, the upper age limit (for all categories) is calculated by adding the minimum required work experience specified in the Terms of Reference to the base age limit. The 10th passed certificate/marksheet, or another government-approved document, is accepted as valid proof of age. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not detail a specific test/interview process; candidates are shortlisted based on eligibility, qualification, and experience as prescribed for each post. If, at any stage of selection, a candidate is found not to fulfil the eligibility criteria or has furnished incorrect/false information or suppressed material facts, their candidature stands cancelled. The Department's decision on any matter relating to selection is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit jrhms.jharkhand.gov.in or recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in. Fill and submit the Online Application Form (OAF) - no other mode of submission is allowed. Provide all mandatory information (marked with an asterisk) in the application form. Upload the required documents: recent profile photograph, signature image, 10th marksheet & certificate, 12th marksheet & certificate, essential qualification documents, essential experience documents (or, for currently employed candidates, appointment letter and last 3 months' salary certificate/bank statement), caste certificate (if required), PH certificate (if applicable), registration certificate (if applicable), and any other document required for the specific position. Pay the application fee, if applicable, and ensure the form is submitted before the closing date. Confirm that the Applicant Status shows "Submitted Successfully" before the deadline of 13 September 2026, 11:59 PM.

content_sections.heading: NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only online applications are valid; applications received through any other source will not be considered. The contract period is for 3 years; no claim for absorption into a regular position will be entertained. Candidates failing to upload the prescribed documents in the relevant sections shall be disqualified. Half-filled applications are treated as incomplete and deemed rejected; incomplete details or an application submitted without photograph/signature/supporting documents shall be rejected. A candidate cannot submit more than one application for a position; multiple/duplicate applications may lead to cancellation of candidature without prior notice. No request for change or correction of any information will be entertained once the online form is submitted. Jharkhand-domicile candidates claiming reservation (ST, SC, BC-I, BC-II, EWS) must submit the Caste/EWS Certificate in the prescribed format issued by the competent authority of Jharkhand. Reservation for Divyang (PH) candidates and sports quota will be applied as per the relevant Government of Jharkhand circular.

faq.question: Q1. What is NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Jharkhand Rural Health Mission Society (National Health Mission, Jharkhand) to fill 51 contractual Accounts and Management posts at State, District, and Block level.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 51 vacancies across 9 positions, the largest being Block Accounts Manager (33 posts) and Accounts Assistant-District-RCH (6 posts).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026?
Q4. What is the qualification required for NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post - from a B.Com/Inter CA/Inter ICWA for Block Accounts Manager to a full Chartered Accountant qualification for the Chartered Accountant post. See the post-wise qualification table above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 35 years for General/EWS, 37 for OBC, 38 for Female Unreserved, and 40 for ST/SC, as on 1 August 2026, with additional relaxation for PH candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By filling the Online Application Form at jrhms.jharkhand.gov.in or recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in before the last date, and uploading all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on eligibility, qualification, and experience as prescribed for each post; the notification does not detail a separate written test or interview stage.

faq.question: Q8. What is the honorarium for NHM Jharkhand Accounts posts?
faq.answer: It ranges from Rs. 19,800 per month (Executive Assistant-Accounts-RCH) to Rs. 75,000 per month (Chartered Accountant), varying by post.
